answer: Two current help-center articles name form NW-LSE-1 (Lease buyout authorization) and would need an update if it were retired. "Selling a car that you lease" (leased_car__2022) says customers can sign NW-LSE-1 so Northwind can request the dealer payoff quote for them. "Getting a payoff letter from your lender" (payoff_letter__2026) sends lease customers to that article and to form NW-LSE-1. Right now NW-LSE-1 is current, with no retirement date and no replacement form.
